# Challenge 4: Mapped Route

Students implement shortest-path search in `GridPlanner`. The supplied map,
grid conversion, and route execution keep geometry and search concerns clear.

This cumulative starter includes every component introduced so far. Continue
with the implementations from Challenge 3, implement `GridPlanner`, and change
each `USE_STUDENT_*` flag in `course_setup.py` only after that component passes
its software tests. With every flag left `False`, the project runs entirely
with the supplied components.
